cases.query: CyTOF mass cytometry clustering gating analysis
cases.reason: CyTOF/mass-cytometry analysis needs marker transformation, clustering, gating, and population abundance interpretation; current registry only has generic flow/FCS parsing or generic clustering.

cases.query: GWAS summary statistics fine mapping colocalization

Microbiome/QIIME2 differential-abundance wording currently drifts to RNA-seq differential-expression or clinical differential-diagnosis skills; track as missing microbiome abundance coverage.
ELISA standard-curve wording currently drifts to decision-curve or generic data-analysis skills; track as missing wet-lab assay quantification coverage.
Western blot densitometry wording currently drifts to figure-legends or RNA-seq transcript quantification; track as missing wet-lab image quantification coverage.

cases.query: qPCR Ct ddCt gene expression analysis
cases.reason: qPCR Ct/ddCt expression-analysis wording currently drifts to expression-matrix normalization, RNA-seq differential-expression, or primer-design skills; track as missing assay quantification coverage.

Pearson/Manders IF colocalization wording currently drifts to electron microscopy, pathology, or broad bioimage-processing skills; track as a missing microscopy quantification skill while preserving generic bioimage queries.
